slack.consent: The AI will be able to read the public channels you invite it into, and your agents will be able to post their results to a channel you choose. This is the only integration that can write anything.

onboarding.sourceIntro: Pick whichever is easiest. Nothing here is required, and you can add more later.

onboarding.dateAmbiguous: Your dates could be either day/month or month/day — every one falls on or before the 12th, so we cannot tell. Which is it?

onboarding.importedSummary: {count} rows are now in your account.
onboarding.importError: The import did not go through.
onboarding.pasteHint: A business plan, meeting notes, a list of clients. We pull out what can be recorded and leave the rest alone.
onboarding.nothingInText: There was nothing in that text worth recording as an entry.
onboarding.analysing: Looking for patterns in your data…
onboarding.analysingHint: Only real patterns from what you just imported. If there is not enough to be sure of anything, we will say so.

onboarding.noneYet: Add a bit more and run this again from your dashboard.
